archetypes.rationale: The change relies on precise eager versus conditional reference classification.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the changed design reference graph and SKILL.md directives. Verify Gate A and failure references remain conditional, Gate B and Gate C slices load unconditionally at their gates, and Step 3 runtime loads before the entry wrapper. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
